entry.intro: Gather everybody once, then let the table vote on what to play — a fresh three to pick from after every game.

leaveConfirm: Leave the tour? The rest of the evening will carry on without you.

lobby.title: Waiting for players
lobby.intro: Everybody joins here once. When you start, the table votes on what to play first.
lobby.willOffer: Three of the {count} game that suits this many will be offered each time. | Three of the {count} games that suit this many will be offered each time.
lobby.none: No game here suits {count} players. Add somebody, or a computer player, and the vote can open.

vote.title: What next?
vote.pick: Pick one, or vote to finish. You can change your mind until the vote closes.
vote.trouble: That game would not open, so here is another vote.

playing.note: The tour waits here until that game ends, and then votes again.

finished.title: The tour is over
finished.played: You played {count} game. | You played {count} games.
finished.nothing: The tour ended before anything was played.

status.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start the tour.

errors.noSettings: A tour has nothing to set: what is played is voted on.
errors.notInThisTour: You are not in this tour.
errors.notOnOffer: That game is not one of the choices.
errors.notOpening: The tour is not opening a game.
errors.notPlaying: The tour is not playing a game.
errors.notFinished: The tour is not over yet.
errors.hostOnlyAgain: Only the host can start another tour.
errors.noGamesForThisMany: No game here can be played by {count}.
